critical_findings.finding: The V3 AST ImportFrom resolver did not implement node.level and package semantics, so its frozen 50-file execution closure omitted local package initializers and imported submodules, including ac_validation, network_grid_need, scopf, service_risk, and osqp_qp.

The V3 protected window ended after release acceptance and spawn-receipt persistence; it did not supervise the controller across the full block lifecycle or close abrupt post-acceptance exit and immutable dual-writer evidence races.
